title: Daily digest: SC upholds Danam Nagender’s disqualifica | Flood alert issued for Musi catchment ar | SC rejects pleas challenging AIMIM MLA’s
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: SC upholds Danam Nagender’s disqualification as Khairatabad MLA.
IMD issued a weather alert for Nalgonda, reports suggest.
SC rejects pleas challenging AIMIM MLA’s Maharashtra election.
bullets_ur: Adalat ne Danam Nagender ki ahliyat khatm karne ka faisla barkarar rakha.
Reports ke mutabiq IMD ne Nalgonda ke liye mausam ka alert jaari kiya.
Adalat ne AIMIM MLA ke Maharashtra intekhab ke khilaf darkhastein mustarid kar dein.
